I think the most productive: let me re-derive what reference "rank 1" might be. Actually, maybe there's a known reference solution for this problem (it's from HDLBits/Verilog practice "PS/2 packet" style). This exact problem is from HDLBits: "Fsm ps2data". The standard solution:

```
module top_module(
    input clk,
    input [7:0] in,
    input reset,
    output [23:0] out_bytes,
    output done);

    reg [1:0] state, next;
    // state encoding
    parameter BYTE1=0, BYTE2=1, BYTE3=2, DONE=3;

    always @(*) begin
        case(state)
            BYTE1: next = in[3] ? BYTE2 : BYTE1;
            BYTE2: next = BYTE3;
            BYTE3: next = DONE;
            DONE:  next = in[3] ? BYTE2 : BYTE1;
        endcase
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) state <= BYTE1;
        else state <= next;
    end
endmodule
```

Actually HDLBits solution:
```
module top_module(
    input clk,
    input [7:0] in,
    input reset,    // Synchronous reset
    output [23:0] out_bytes,
    output done);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    parameter BYTE1=2'd0, BYTE2=2'd1, BYTE3=2'd2, DONE=2'd3;
    
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            BYTE1:   next_state = in[3] ? BYTE2 : BYTE1;
            BYTE2:   next_state = BYTE3;
            BYTE3:   next_state = DONE;
            DONE:    next_state = in[3] ? BYTE2 : BYTE1;
            default: next_state = BYTE1;
        endcase
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= BYTE1;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
        end
    end
    
    // done
    assign done = (state == DONE);
    
    // out_bytes
    reg [7:0] byte1, byte2, byte3;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (state == BYTE1) byte1 <= in; ...
    end
endmodule
```
